Hello! I absolutely love your art style and have been following your work for a while. I would be thrilled to have the opportunity to collaborate with you!

I would like to commission an illustration of two characters from my reference sheet. They are based on historical figures from China’s Wei-Jin and Northern-Southern Dynasties period (original fictional designs, not copyrighted). I am currently very obsessed with their dynamic!

Character Dynamics:

Fu Jian (Bottom): He is a lively and energetic character. He always leads the atmosphere between them and often initiates intimate gestures without any hesitation.

Yao Chang (Top): When facing Fu Jian, he often appears reserved, shy, and even a bit timid or hesitant. However, deep down, he truly loves and craves Fu Jian’s touch and intimacy.

I would love for you to draw an illustration of them together. I'm happy to give you full creative freedom regarding the pose, composition, and even the outfits. I trust your artistic vision!

Thank you so much for your time and consideration. I look forward to hearing from you!
